title: Everything in C is undefined behavior
summary: An analysis exploring the provocative claim that many common C programming patterns actually constitute undefined behavior according to the C standard, even when they work correctly in practice. The article delves into technical nuances of the C specification and compiler optimization implications.
problem_solved: Raises awareness about the disconnect between common C coding practices and what the C standard actually guarantees as defined behavior.
why_valuable: Helps developers understand the hidden risks in C code that may appear to work but technically invokes undefined behavior with potential security and portability implications.
